name: Tirolerheim
beschreibung:
History

A website that itself runs an inn or a pension named Tirolerheim in Schmirn was not found. FreizeitMonster lists a pension Tirolerheim in St. Jodok am Brenner (Schmirn), postcode 6154. The same page claims that internet and Wi-Fi are not available. Further details on the operator, the year of construction, rooms or the kitchen are missing there. The well-known Tirolerheim at Neuwaldegger Straße 18–18a, 1170 Wien, is a student residence for students from Nordtirol, Osttirol and Südtirol and has nothing to do with this entry. Older descriptive texts that place the Tirolerheim in the Stubaital and claim a Tyrolean menu, wooden furniture, Wi-Fi and parking spaces match neither the directory nor the Schmirntal and are not adopted. The directory entry names St. Jodok am Brenner or Schmirn. The Stubaital does not appear in it.

Getting there

A street, a house number and a timetable of this business are not published. The directory entry names only St. Jodok am Brenner or Schmirn, 6154. Without an address no stop can be assigned in a reliable way.

Tips

As long as no business confirms a telephone number, rooms or prices, a booking via this data set cannot be documented. The Wi-Fi statement comes from FreizeitMonster alone and should not count as checked house rules. Other houses in the Schmirntal, for example the Gästehaus Fischer or the Alplodge, are separate businesses and do not replace this entry.
kurzbeschreibung: Directory entry for a pension Tirolerheim in St. Jodok am Brenner (Schmirn). No business website. Not the Tiroler student residence in Wien.
